new_roles.description:
**About us:**
At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Driven by a passion for excellence, we partner with leading Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences and Industrial companies to design, manufacture and service some of the world’s most transformative products, including advanced surgical systems, diagnostic instruments, healthcare imaging equipment, mission critical aerospace systems, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.
 
 
**When we invest in our people, we invest in building a better world.**
With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. It is our values that unite us and guide us in everything that we do, including how we operate, behave and interact to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.
 
 
Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.
 
 
As a team member, you will engage in impactful work through global collaboration and the use of emerging technologies, join an inclusive culture where every team member is valued and working toward a greater purpose, and be empowered to reach your full potential through various development programs designed to accelerate your growth.
 
 
Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. We also prioritize work-life balance and offer a variety of perks to enhance the team member experience. For more information, visit our US benefits website at usbenefits.plexus.com. Our commitment to pay range transparency fosters an equitable workplace, where everyone can feel valued. The annual compensation range for this position is stated below. The salary offered within this range will be based upon the geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level. Salary Range:
 
 
$132,500.00 - $198,700.00
 
 
**Purpose Statement:**
To provide leadership and direction to the Manufacturing Engineering team(s) from a functional perspective. Manage the Manufacturing Engineering function in line with functional specific strategies, process and systems development, people development, employee relations, plant level metrics.
 
 
**Key Job Accountabilities**

* Lead manufacturing-engineering excellence by collaborating with various functional leads to ensure engineering capability meets or exceeds manufacturing standards for quality product delivery.
* Support Program Management initiatives and activities to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Lead process/product/equipment engineering activities in compliance with Plexus Core Values to meet industry standards, regulatory and customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to site operations, establish a technology roadmap, and collaborate with corporate and regional technical teams to achieve lower costs and higher manufacturing returns.
* Responsible to exemplify and hold their team accountable to demonstrating the Plexus Core Values. Leader will focus on evaluating potential, driving succession planning, and ensuring their employees receive the development and coaching required to realize their full potential.

**Education/Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.
* Proven leadership skills and management experience.

*This document does not represent a contract of employment and is not intended to capture every possible assignment the incumbent could be asked to perform.*
We are pleased to provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities or special requirements. If you need an application accommodation, please contact us by email at GHQ.TA@plexus.com. Please include your contact information and clearly describe how we can help you. This email is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 
 
Some offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a drug screen and/or background check.

new_roles.description:
**What To Expect**
Tesla is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer to build and lead a team of engineers focused on high-volume production launches. This role will drive the development of scalable manufacturing systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product designs for manufacturability, accelerate assembly processes, and implement automation solutions. In this fast-paced, demanding environment, you’ll play a pivotal role in scaling Tesla’s SI robotics initiatives while advancing our mission to achieve sustainable abundance through innovative manufacturing practices.
 
 
**What You'll Do**- Lead Manufacturing Engineering Team: Build, mentor, and scale high-performing teams to design and deploy high-volume production systems, ensuring alignment with Tesla’s speed and quality objectives
- Collaborate with Equipment Suppliers: Partner with internal and external suppliers to engineer, install, and validate production equipment, accelerating line ramp-up to meet volume targets
- Validate Requirements and Constraints: Use first principles analysis to rigorously assess product and process requirements, eliminating ambiguity and ensuring all elements are purpose-driven and essential
- Optimize Production Processes: Identify and remove non-value-added steps in workflows, prioritizing functional simplicity before pursuing automation or advanced optimization
- Improve Cycle Time: Analyze production bottlenecks and implement solutions to increase process speed, throughput, and overall line efficiency
- Deploy Automation Solutions: Strategically integrate automation as a final step after process simplification, ensuring systems are robust, high-speed, and scalable
- Ensure Seamless Operational Transitions: Coordinate with operations teams during ramp-up phases, delivering detailed documentation and training to sustain engineering teams for long-term success

new_roles.title: Director of Product Development & Industrialization
new_roles.description:
At Horizon Hobby, we inspire dreams and help build memories! Our company is the leader in the global Radio Control industry, celebrating 40 years in 2025! We offer tremendous opportunities for growth and development and a full array of benefits including discounts on our products! We are currently hiring for a Director of Product Development and Industrialization at our Pro-Line office in Banning CA!
 
 
*This is a full time, on-site position at our Pro-Line facility in Banning California. Workings hours will be Monday-Friday 8am-5pm PST.*
**Typical pay for this position is $105,000-$125,000. The final offer for this position will be based on the unique experience and qualifications of the candidate selected. This position may also be eligible for a bonus not included in the base pay range.**
The Director of Product Development & Industrialization will provide strategic leadership for the development, commercialization, and industrialization of proprietary hobby products from concept through production. This role will be leading our Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization resources while overseeing the systems, processes, tooling, molds, manufacturing equipment, and technical capabilities required to deliver innovative, high-quality products to market.
 
 
This role will partner closely with Brand, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Tooling, and external partners to identify market opportunities, translate customer needs into successful products, and ensure products are designed, developed, and launched efficiently. The role balances technical excellence with business performance, ensuring product investments align with growth objectives, customer demand, profitability targets, and long-term strategic priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Innovation & Strategy
 
 

* Partner with Brand and cross-functional teams to define product roadmaps, priorities, resources, and timelines.
* Drive innovation and development investments that strengthen market position, customer satisfaction, growth, and return on investment.
* Identify and prioritize new product opportunities using customer insight, competitive analysis, market trends, and commercial potential.

Product Development Leadership
 
 

* Lead and develop Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization teams supporting proprietary products.
* Own product development from concept and engineering through validation, launch, and lifecycle management.
* Strengthen quality, scalability, execution, and organizational capability through standards, coaching, succession planning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Business & Commercial Leadership
 
 

* Monitor portfolio performance and align cross-functional priorities to achieve revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
* Contribute to portfolio planning, market expansion, long-range growth, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Provide senior leadership with business reviews, development updates, performance metrics, and recommendations.

Industrialization & Manufacturing Readiness
 
 

* Lead new-product industrialization from concept through launch, applying DFM and DFA to optimize quality, scalability, cost, and manufacturing readiness.
* Partner across Engineering, Manufacturing, Tool Room, suppliers, and development teams to resolve challenges and improve processes, tooling, and capacity.
* Track launch, readiness, quality, and productivity performance to drive continuous improvement.

Tooling, Equipment & Technology
 
 

* Define requirements and roadmaps for molds, tooling, fixtures, machinery, automation, and manufacturing technology.
* Lead capital planning and business cases that improve capability, productivity, quality, cost, and return on investment.
* Manage external tooling and manufacturing partners, strengthen internal capabilities, and maintain effective engineering data and technical documentation processes.

Supplier & Partner Management
 
 

* Build strategic relationships with domestic and international manufacturing, tooling, engineering, and supplier partners.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities and performance to improve quality, speed, cost competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.

*Success in this role requires strong leadership across innovation, engineering, manufacturing, and business functions to continuously improve speed to market, product quality, operational performance, and return on investment*
**Required**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in product management, category management, business management, product development, or a related leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience leading and developing teams.
* Demonstrated success growing a product category, business unit, or consumer product portfolio.
* Experience developing and launching successful products from concept through commercialization.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, business cases, and profitability.
* Proven ability to develop business strategies and translate them into measurable results.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Ability to travel as required for customer visits, product testing, trade shows, industry events, and supplier meetings.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the RC, hobby products, powersports, automotive aftermarket, consumer products, or related industries.
* Experience working directly with enthusiast communities, racers, influencers, or brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, new product introduction, and global sourcing environments.
* Experience using product lifecycle management (PLM) and project management systems.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasional lifting of office supplies and materials, up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on a computer.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.*
**Benefits & Other Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* HSA and FSA options
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Life Insurance and Supplemental Life Insurance
* 401(k) with a company match
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Internal Rewards
* Discounts on Products
* Additional Coverage such as accident, critical, hospital and pet insurance

*Horizon Hobby is a progressive, innovative company and, as such, is constantly reevaluating and reinventing the processes and procedures associated with each job. The essential duties and responsibilities of this position may change at any time. In addition, employees may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work necessary or important to the operation of Horizon. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected and appreciated.*
**Horizon Hobby, LLC is an equal opportunity and E-Verify employer**

new_roles.title: Director Engineering (New Product Development)
new_roles.description:
Conair, a member of the Piovan Group, is the leading producer of auxiliary equipment for plastics processing in the world. We make and market over 450 different products, including resin-drying systems, blenders, feeders and material-conveying systems, temperature-control equipment and granulators. Extrusion solutions include gravimetric control systems, film and sheet scrap-reclaim systems and downstream equipment for pipe and profile extrusion. Conair is also a leader in plastics process integration, engineering and installing complete manufacturing systems that help plastics processors manage their valuable raw materials, handle their critical manufactured parts, and improve their process yield.

**Purpose**

The Director of New Product Development (NPD) Engineering is responsible for leading the design and development of Conair's next generation of auxiliary equipment for plastics processing, from concept through production launch. This position leads the NPD Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Advanced Research / Co-op groups and serves as the senior mechanical engineering authority for new products. The Director drives NPD projects through Conair's stage-gate process, manages engineering schedules and deliverables, and mentors and develops a team of engineers and designers. The Director works closely with Product Management, Sustainment Engineering, Manufacturing, and Purchasing to deliver new products that meet customer, cost, quality, and compliance targets. This position is located in Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Drive NPD projects through Conair's stage-gate process from concept through launch, including requirements definition, gate deliverables, design reviews, and gate recommendations.
* Manage engineering schedules, resources, budgets, and deliverables across the NPD project portfolio, including alpha and beta prototype builds and release to production, and report status to engineering leadership.
* Serve as the technical lead and senior mechanical engineering authority for new products: set the design approach, lead design reviews and problem solving, ensure sound design practice (calculations, tolerance analysis, GD&T, materials selection, documentation standards), and identify patentable inventions.
* Lead design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA), design-to-cost, and value engineering, including designs suited to sheet metal fabrication, weldments, castings, machined and molded components.
* Plan and oversee prototype testing, verification and validation, and DFMEA with the Lab, and ensure new products meet applicable safety and regulatory requirements (e.g., UL, CE, NFPA 79).
* Partner with Product Management to translate voice-of-customer and business-case requirements into product specifications, and support product launches, including trade show display equipment.
* Coordinate mechanical, electrical, controls, and software development, and work with Purchasing and suppliers on sourcing, tooling, and cost targets, to deliver integrated, manufacturable designs.
* Transition new products smoothly into production and Sustainment Engineering with complete and accurate drawings, bills of material, specifications, and manuals.
* Mentor engineers and designers, building technical depth, design judgment, and project skills across the team, and support Conair's engineering co-op program.
* Review, hire, and train engineering staff; set goals, manage performance and workloads, and develop future technical leaders.
* Establish and track key performance metrics, such as gate schedule adherence, product cost versus target, and launch quality, and drive continuous improvement of the NPD process.
* Collaborate with Conair's engineering teams in the U.S., Italy, and India, and cultivate an environment which encourages teamwork, innovation, trust, and customer-inspired motivation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering required; Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA a plus.
* Position typically expects 12+ years of mechanical design and product development experience in industrial equipment or machinery, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams; plastics processing auxiliary equipment, extrusion, or injection molding experience strongly preferred.
* Proven record of taking new products from concept through production launch using a stage-gate or phase-gate process.
* Strong hands-on mechanical design background, including sheet metal, weldments, castings, machined and molded parts, mechanisms, pneumatics, and heat transfer, airflow, or fluid systems.
* Strong working knowledge of GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, DFMEA, and design verification and validation; familiarity with 3D CAD and PDM/PLM systems sufficient to review designs and guide the team; FEA or simulation experience a plus.
* Demonstrated DFM/DFA, design-to-cost, and value engineering results; experience designing for in-house sheet metal fabrication a plus.
* Familiarity with electrical controls, PLCs, and machine safety standards (e.g., NFPA 79, UL 508A, CE Machinery Directive).
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop engineers and designers and to manage schedules, resources, budgets, and competing priorities in a cross-functional organization; working knowledge of ERP systems.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, sound decision-making, and strong structured problem-solving (e.g., 8D, 5-Why, root cause analysis), with the ability to work effectively with customers, Product Management, and executive leadership.
* Ability to travel 10-15% of the time, including visits to customers, suppliers, trade shows, and Conair facilities, with occasional international travel.

Piovan Group is a world leader in the development and production of systems for the automation of production processes for the storage, transport and treatment of polymers, plastic, and food powders. The Group is close to its customers, on a global basis, through continuous technical assistance and support from the design phase to the installation and start-up of the system.

Customers, People, Innovation. These are the pillars of our philosophy that have led us to grow in a path that began more than fifty years ago, pursuing our development objectives with honesty, integrity, and transparency.

**Piovan Group offers an outstanding compensation and benefits package including profit sharing, bonus plans, 401(k) with company match, medical insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, health club reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, employee assistance, and employee referral bonus program.**

*Piovan Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and offers employment opportunities to all qualified persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability (except where physical or mental abilities are a bona fide occupational requirement), veteran status, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, HIV-positive status, possession of the sickle cell trait, genetic characteristics, political views, and any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws.*

new_roles.title: Corporate Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Take the next step with an exciting and growing company
 
As the only fully integrated maker of premium quality wire, rope, and assemblies, Loos & Co holds a leading position in the global aerospace sector.
 
A division of the Central Wire (CWI) Group of Companies encompassing 12 locations in three countries, 750+ employees, and over six decades of excellence, Loos & Co solutions are found in mission critical flight control applications. Our precision-manufactured components are also used for defense, med tech, and heavy industry purposes around the world, in large part because of the people behind our products.
 
Do you have a strong work ethic? Take pride in a job well done? Are you passionate about contributing to individual and team, company and customer successes? If you’re interested in joining a dynamic work environment that offers opportunities to reach your full potential, we want to hear from you.
 
 
Position Summary / Essential Function
 
The Corporate Director of Quality is CWI’s senior enterprise Quality leader and is responsible for establishing and sustaining a culture of quality excellence, accountability, customer focus, product safety, and continuous improvement across aerospace, commercial, medical, metal rope, and assembly facilities. Based in Pomfret Center, Connecticut and reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director leads the enterprise Quality function, develops high-performing teams of Quality professionals, and establishes the governance, systems, standards, metrics, and decision rights required for consistent execution across all locations.
 
A central responsibility of the role is to create a results- and data-driven culture in which decisions are based on objective evidence, process capability, customer and regulatory requirements, risk, and measurable business outcomes. The Director advances the organization from reactive inspection and problem resolution toward prevention, disciplined problem solving, statistical thinking, robust corrective action, and sustained operational excellence.
 
The Director maintains the effectiveness and certification readiness of applicable quality management systems, including AS9100D and ISO 9001 for aviation, space, defense, and commercial operations; ISO 13485 for medical-device operations where applicable; and customer-, product-, and facility-specific requirements for metal rope, wire rope, cable, and assemblies. The role ensures that customer and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements take precedence where they exceed or conflict with general quality-system requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Build, lead, develop, and retain a high-performing organization of Quality professionals across CWI, with clear roles, decision rights, measurable objectives, development plans, succession pipelines, and performance expectations.
* Create a results- and data-driven culture of Quality excellence in which teams use objective evidence, trend analysis, statistical methods, and risk-based thinking to identify priorities, prevent defects, and verify sustained improvement.
* Establish and execute the enterprise Quality strategy, organizational design, staffing plan, technical roadmap, and resource priorities in alignment with CWI business and operating objectives.
* Own enterprise governance for quality management systems and maintain certification readiness for applicable aerospace, commercial, medical, metal rope, and assembly facilities, including registrar, customer, regulatory, and internal audits.
* Ensure aerospace quality controls address AS9100D requirements, including operational risk management, configuration management, product safety, counterfeit-parts prevention, special-process control, production process verification, foreign-object damage prevention, traceability, and awareness of ethical behavior.
* Ensure first article inspection and production process verification practices align with AS9102 when contractually applicable, and ensure special processes are qualified, controlled, and approved to customer, regulatory, or other requirements where applicable.
* Ensure medical quality-system controls align with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory and customer requirements, including risk management, validated processes, traceability, complaint handling, CAPA, change control, and record retention.
* Establish common standards for document and record control, calibration, inspection and test, nonconforming output, CAPA, root-cause analysis, internal auditing, management review, supplier quality, customer complaints, product and process change control, and continuous improvement.
* Establish an enterprise Quality performance-management system with leading and lagging indicators for customer complaints, escapes, first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, supplier defects, audit findings, process capability, CAPA aging, recurrence, and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Lead monthly operating reviews and formal management reviews that convert Quality data into executive-level insights, identify systemic and emerging risks, assign accountable owners, and track actions through verified closure.
* Develop Quality leaders who can influence Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams; make risk-based decisions; escalate product-safety or conformity concerns; and hold the organization accountable for results.
* Serve as the senior Quality escalation point for significant customer complaints, product escapes, product-safety events, audit findings, systemic nonconformances, supplier-quality issues, and certification or regulatory risks.
* Ensure robust containment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, effectiveness verification, and lessons-learned deployment for significant or recurring failures, including consideration of human factors where relevant.
* Provide enterprise oversight for supplier-quality strategy, supplier qualification, risk-based surveillance, source inspection, flow-down of customer and regulatory requirements, and supplier corrective action.
* Partner with the Chief Operating Officer, Plant Managers, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Commercial, and other leaders to integrate Quality into operational performance, new-product introduction, manufacturing transfers, and change management.
* Communicate Quality-system health, certification status, customer performance, material risks, resource needs, and improvement results clearly to executive leadership and the Board or ownership group when requested.
* Perform other related duties consistent with the role, grade, and business needs.

Required Qualifications
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, Quality, Manufacturing, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Twelve or more years of progressive Quality, manufacturing, engineering, or operational leadership experience in regulated or high-reliability manufacturing.
* At least seven years of direct people-leadership experience, including leadership of Quality managers and professionals, performance management, coaching, organizational design, and succession planning.
* At least five years of multi-site or enterprise Quality leadership experience with accountability for common systems, audits, metrics, and cross-site standardization.
* Demonstrated responsibility for an AS9100D-certified quality management system and successful participation as the senior Quality leader in at least one third-party certification or recertification cycle.
* Demonstrated experience with internal and external audit programs, management review, CAPA, root-cause analysis, configuration and change control, supplier quality, product safety, traceability, nonconformance control, and customer complaint resolution.
* Demonstrated use of Quality data and statistical methods to improve performance, including examples of measurable reduction in defects, escapes, cost of poor quality, or recurring corrective actions.
* Ability to travel approximately 25% to 40% to CWI facilities, customer sites, supplier sites, and audit locations, with additional travel during significant launches, audits, or quality events.
* Ability to communicate technical and business risk, priorities, decisions, and performance clearly to plant, functional, customer, registrar, and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
 

* Experience in specialty metals, wire, cable, wire rope, aircraft cable, mechanical cable, swaging, metal assemblies, or other highly engineered metal products.
* Experience leading Quality in aerospace and defense manufacturing, including customer flow-downs, AS9102 first article inspection, source inspection, special processes, counterfeit-parts controls, configuration management, product safety, and foreign-object damage prevention.
* Experience with ISO 13485-certified medical-device manufacturing and risk-management practices aligned with ISO 14971 where applicable.
* Experience with Nadcap-accredited special processes, Defense Contract Management Agency oversight, Federal Aviation Administration-regulated products, or major aerospace prime and Tier 1 customer requirements, as applicable to CWI’s business.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Operations, Quality, or Business Administration.
* Experience using an electronic QMS, ERP, business-intelligence, and statistical software to manage Quality performance and traceability.

Preferred Certifications
 

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) or equivalent senior Quality leadership credential.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or AS9100 Lead Auditor certification.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.
* Certified Manufacturing Engineer, Professional Engineer, Project Management Professional, or comparable technical credential as relevant.

Key Leadership Competencies
 

* Enterprise Quality leadership and culture building
* Leadership, development, and retention of Quality professionals
* Results orientation and measurable accountability
* Data-driven decision making and statistical thinking
* AS9100D, ISO 9001, and regulated quality-system leadership
* Product safety, compliance, and risk-based judgment
* CAPA, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action effectiveness
* Customer quality and executive escalation
* Cross-functional influence and change leadership
* Continuous improvement and operational excellence
* Executive communication and management review
* Multi-site governance and standardization

Leadership Standard
 
Success in this position is measured not simply by maintaining certifications or passing audits, but by the Director’s ability to build capable Quality leaders and teams, establish measurable accountability, improve the effectiveness of CWI’s quality systems, reduce recurring failures and customer escapes, strengthen process capability, protect product safety and conformity, and demonstrate sustained improvement through objective performance data.
 
Physical and Work Environment Requirements
 
The role operates in office and active manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with plant operations. It may require walking or standing on production floors, observing machinery and manufacturing activities, using a computer and quality information systems, and communicating in areas where hearing protection or other personal protective equipment is required. Travel among company locations, customer sites, supplier sites, and audit locations is expected. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law. This description identifies the essential functions of the position but is not intended to list every physical activity or working condition.
 
Base Salary Range
 
$142,000-$204,500
 
Benefits
 
Subject to the terms, eligibility requirements, and amendment provisions of the applicable plans and policies:
 

* 401(k) with matching
* Dental insurance

new_roles.title: Director, Quality
new_roles.description:
**Job Details**
---------------

**Job Title: Director, Quality**

**Location: Meriden, CT**

**Work Arrangement:** Onsite

**About the Role**
------------------

**The Director of Quality** provides leadership, direction, and support to the Quality team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus. This role is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and consistent manufacture, validation, and delivery of chemical products while maintaining the highest standards of quality and operational excellence. As a leader of the Quality Team, the Director coaches, develops, and empowers team members to achieve individual and departmental goals, build technical expertise, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. The Director also ensures timely and effective management of quality-related communications, processes and programs that support both customer satisfaction and business growth. Working closely with colleagues across Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Sales, and Customer Service, the Director of Quality establishes and maintains robust quality systems, drives regulatory compliance, and identifies opportunities to improve processes, reduce risk, and enhance product integrity. Through strong leadership and partnership, this role helps ensure customer requirements are met, supports the company's commitment to safety and quality, and contributes to the organization's long-term success and reputation in the marketplace.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Provide leadership for functional area
* Establish and ensure Quality policies, standards, and objectives ensuring best practices through benchmarking and collaboration with regional and corporate colleagues
* Drive overall compliance ensuring on-time completion of key deliverables
* Responsible for document control, SOP’s, master training schedule, Certificates of Conformance, review and approve relabel PITAs etc.
* Review and approve all quality reports such as annual product review, temperature mapping, validation, internal audit, etc.
* Conducting timely audits, management reviews batch review and release, supply chain, supplier and product qualification
* Advises leadership on quality risks, compliance matters, and strategic quality improvement opportunities
* Driving continuous improvement and risk assessment initiatives
 

**Decision-Making and Problem Solving**

 

* Establishes and approves quality policies, procedures, standards, and quality objectives
* Makes final decisions regarding product release, product disposition, and quality-related exceptions
* Determines appropriate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) in response to quality events, customer complaints, audit findings, and nonconformances.
* Decides when production processes, materials, or products fail to meet quality or regulatory requirements and may halt production or shipment when necessary
* Evaluates and approves supplier quality programs, qualification processes, and remediation plans
* Recommends investments in quality systems, laboratory capabilities, technology, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Serves as the organization's lead authority during regulatory inspections, customer audits, and significant quality incidents

**Skills**
----------

* Ability to drive Quality focus throughout the organization
* Strong strategic thinking and problem solving skills
* Experience in developing and maintaining Quality Management Systems
* Expertise in Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
* Demonstrated ability in leading and managing audits and regulatory inspections
* Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities
* Ability to manage large teams and projects
* Strong communication and influencing skills
* Change management

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biology, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related scientific discipline required
* Master's degree in a related field preferred
* 7 - 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or regulated chemical manufacturing industry
* 5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing professional teams
* Experience leading Quality Management Systems (QMS) within a cGMP-regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience interacting with regulatory agencies, customers, and external auditors

**About Caldic**
----------------

At BrandNu, a Caldic Company, we’re a global leader in distribution solutions, serving diverse markets across the world. Joining us means becoming part of an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and innovation-driven team.

 

**We offer:**

* Competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, legal, 401(k) with company contributions, paid time off and more
* An inclusive, diverse, and dynamic work environment
* The chance to shape the future of specialty ingredient solutions across industries like food, pharma, personal care, and more

We operate in 43 countries around the world. Our innovative solutions are tailored to meet the needs of industries such as food, pharma, personal care, and industrial markets, ensuring sustainable success for all stakeholders. To learn more, visit: www.caldic.com

 

**Ready to Join Us?**

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and join a global leader, apply now at BrandNu Laboratories, a Caldic company!

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Caldic celebrates diversity and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, or any other characteristic.

new_roles.title: Director, Data & AI Governance, Quality & Assurance
new_roles.description:
As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development, and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides an opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and the opportunity to directly contribute to the company's success. We realize that our strength and competitive advantage lie with our people. We support our employees in several ways to foster a healthy working environment, meaningful work, mobility, networking, and work-life balance. Our competitive compensation and benefit programs reflect Boehringer Ingelheim's high regard for our employees.
 
 
The head, Data & AI Governance, Quality & Assurance is accountable for data & AI trust, quality, transparency, compliance, and responsible use across data products, AI products, analytical assets, and agents within the U.S. organization. The role owns U.S. governance frameworks, controls, quality and assurance standards, stewardship expectations, and independent oversight across the lifecycle, aligned with applicable global policies and standards.
 
 
The Data & AI Governance, Quality & Assurance sets acceptance criteria, identifies and escalates material risks, provides evidence for accountable decisions, and drives adoption of AI and agentic workflows to modernize data and AI governance, quality, and assurance across the U.S. organization.

 

This role is based on-site at our Ridgefield, CT location with hybrid flexibility of 2-3 days per week on-site.

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Owns the U.S. Data & AI governance and assurance framework, aligned with global policies and standards.
* Defines policies, standards, controls, and accountability structures.
* Sets data quality, stewardship, observability, and assurance expectations.
* Governs metadata, catalog, lineage, access, permitted use, and information-management policy.
* Governs KPI, business-rule, ontology, semantic, and AI or agent registration processes.
* Defines responsible AI controls and independent validation criteria.
* Provides independent lifecycle oversight and risk-acceptance recommendations.
* Builds governance, quality, stewardship, and assurance capability.
* Drives adoption of AI and agentic workflows to modernize data and AI governance, quality, stewardship, and assurance processes.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Data Science, Computer Science, Law, Risk, Quality, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field required.
* MSc, MBA, JD, or relevant graduate degree; governance, risk, audit, quality, privacy, security, or responsible AI credentials are advantageous preferred.
* Twelve-plus (12+) years of relevant experience, including senior leadership in governance, risk, compliance, quality, assurance, or information management within a complex U.S. organization.
* Demonstrated success establishing governance frameworks, decision rights, controls, stewardship models, and independent assurance across complex organizations.
* Deep knowledge of data quality, metadata, lineage, catalogs, access, permitted use, observability, issue management, and control evidence.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, model and agent governance, lifecycle controls, registration, validation, monitoring, and release assurance.
* Demonstrated success redesigning governance and quality processes and driving adoption of AI and agentic workflows, with measurable improvements in effectiveness, efficiency, transparency, and user experience.

* Strong analytical judgment, executive communication, regulatory influence, and escalation capability.

new_roles.title: APP Medical Director, Quality & Safety
new_roles.description:
**Help shape the clinical future of one of the region's most respected healthcare organizations.**

Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care is seeking an experienced Advanced Practice Provider leader to serve as **APP Medical Director, Quality & Safety**.

The Medical Director reports to the Chief Medical Officer and provides direct leadership to an assigned group of providers and Lead Providers, while holding network-wide responsibility for clinical quality standards, quality surveillance, patient safety, and performance improvement across Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care. This senior leadership position combines meaningful clinical practice with the opportunity to advance evidence-based care and strengthen clinical performance across a growing network in Connecticut and New York.

**Why Join Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care?**

* Regional leadership opportunity with impact across urgent care centers throughout Connecticut and New York.
* Partnership with an experienced and collaborative medical leadership team.
* Ability to influence clinical quality, safety, and provider performance at scale.
* Opportunity to mentor providers and develop future clinical leaders.
* Strong operational infrastructure and organizational support.
* Continued clinical practice while serving in a senior leadership role.
* Proudly affiliated with Yale New Haven Health.

**A Regional Leadership Opportunity**

Working collaboratively with the Chief Medical Officer, fellow Medical Directors, Lead Providers, and operational leaders, the APP Medical Director, Quality & Safety will translate clinical performance data, quality findings, and emerging risks into meaningful improvements in care delivery, provider performance, and patient outcomes.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide direct leadership, performance management, coaching, and professional development for an assigned group of Advanced Practice Providers.
* Directly supervise and develop assigned Lead Providers, supporting their effectiveness in provider oversight, clinical escalation, and quality improvement.
* Lead network-wide clinical quality and patient safety initiatives, including quality surveillance, clinical event review, clinical risk identification, and performance improvement.

* Establish and oversee chart review, documentation integrity, coding accuracy, and provider feedback processes, ensuring findings translate into appropriate corrective actions and measurable improvements in clinical care.

* Develop and monitor evidence-based clinical standards, including diagnostic testing, clinically significant results follow-up, referral and escalation processes, and adherence to established clinical protocols.

* Partner with the Chief Medical Officer and operational leadership on clinical governance, regulatory readiness, and risk mitigation.

* Maintain meaningful clinical practice while serving in a leadership capacity.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful leader in this role will:

* Demonstrate measurable improvements in clinical quality, patient safety, and provider performance across the urgent care network.

* Develop and support high-performing providers and Lead Providers through effective coaching, accountability, and professional development.

* Use clinical performance data, chart review findings, and quality metrics to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and sustain results.

* Foster consistent, evidence-based care and a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across geographically diverse teams.

* Champion a patient-centered approach to urgent care that supports timely access, appropriate clinical management, and seamless coordination across the Yale New Haven Health delivery network.

**Qualifications**

* Current unrestricted PA or APRN licensure and appropriate board certification.
* Significant urgent care clinical experience with expertise managing the broad range of acute illnesses, injuries, and procedures encountered in urgent care practice.
* Substantial clinical leadership experience, including direct provider supervision, performance management, accountability for clinical quality and patient safety outcomes, and successful implementation of measurable clinical improvement initiatives.
* Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience leading across multiple clinical sites and utilizing quality and performance data to drive improvement strongly preferred.
* Ability to travel throughout the region as needed to support providers, quality initiatives, and operational priorities.

**Working Arrangement**

* This is a regional, multi-site leadership position supporting Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care locations throughout Connecticut and New York. The position is not assigned to a single clinical site and requires travel throughout the network.
* Clinical Commitment: 0.3 FTE.
* Medical Leadership Responsibilities: 0.7 FTE.

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**

If you're an accomplished Advanced Practice Provider with a passion for clinical leadership, quality improvement, and patient safety, we invite you to explore this opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care network.

**Apply today to learn more.**

new_roles.title: Sr. Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
The Senior Director of Quality is responsible for leading quality, regulatory compliance, and functions at an assigned facility while providing strategic leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments across multiple FCAH locations and operating companies. This role ensures compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, customer, and industry requirements while driving consistency in quality standards, processes, audit readiness, corrective actions, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

The Senior Director serves as a hands-on quality leader at their assigned location while partnering with site leadership and other Quality leaders to strengthen quality systems, address regulatory and operational risks, develop quality teams, and promote a culture of accountability, safety, and excellence across the organization.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Site Quality Leadership**

* Lead and manage the Quality department at the assigned facility, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
* Partner with site leadership, Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other departments to integrate quality into daily operations and decision-making.
* Oversee site quality personnel, including staffing, performance management, training, development, and accountability.
* Ensure the facility maintains required certifications, approvals, manuals, procedures, and quality systems.
* Monitor site quality performance, identify areas of risk, and develop action plans to address deficiencies and improve operational performance.

**Multi-Site Quality Leadership & Support**

* Provide leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments and leaders across other First Class Air operating companies and locations.
* Partner with site Quality leaders to identify challenges, strengthen quality processes, and improve regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Promote consistency in quality standards, processes, procedures, and best practices across locations where appropriate.
* Assist other locations with quality initiatives, regulatory concerns, audit preparation, corrective actions, customer issues, and process improvement efforts.
* Conduct site visits to evaluate quality systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide support to local Quality teams.
* Share lessons learned, recurring quality issues, and best practices across locations to prevent repeat findings and improve overall organizational performance.
* Help develop and implement company-wide quality initiatives while allowing for site-specific requirements, certifications, and regulatory differences.
* Escalate significant regulatory, operational, customer, or quality risks to executive leadership.

**Regulatory Compliance & Oversight**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, UK CAA, , customer, and other regulatory requirements, as applicable to company operations.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, including Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Serve as a point of contact for regulatory authorities, customer representatives, and external auditors, as appropriate.
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure applicable requirements are communicated and implemented across affected locations.
* Ensure maintenance, repair, overhaul, inspection, manufacturing, and other applicable activities are performed in accordance with approved technical data, regulatory requirements, and established procedures.
* Maintain organizational readiness for regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) at the assigned location and across other locations as needed.
* Establish and promote consistent quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices across the organization.
* Oversee the development, revision, and implementation of quality manuals, procedures, inspection programs, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate document control, records management, inspection processes, calibration programs, personnel qualifications, training, and other critical quality system controls are maintained.
* Partner with site and enterprise leadership to improve quality processes, reduce risk, and enhance operational performance.

**Audits, Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and oversee internal, external, regulatory, customer, and third-party audits at the assigned facility.
* Support and provide guidance to other locations in preparation for and execution of audits.
* Develop and support risk-based audit schedules and audit strategies.
* Ensure audit findings and quality issues are appropriately investigated, contained, corrected, and documented.
* Oversee corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes and ensure root cause analysis is appropriately performed.
* Verify corrective actions are effective and prevent recurring issues.
* Identify recurring findings, systemic quality issues, and trends across locations and implement improvements where appropriate.

**Airworthiness & Technical Quality**

* Provide oversight of airworthiness and return-to-service processes across applicable repair station operations.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for FAA Form 8130-3, EASA Form 1, inspection, certification, and related airworthiness documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure receiving, in-process, and final inspections are performed in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
* Oversee the management and control of capability lists, personnel authorizations, technician and inspector qualifications, stamps, and related records.
* Ensure calibration programs and control of tools, equipment, and test instruments meet applicable requirements.
* Assist other locations with technical quality concerns, inspection processes, airworthiness issues, and regulatory interpretations as needed.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Provide leadership and support in resolving significant customer quality concerns, escalations, and recurring issues.
* Partner with Sales, Operations, Maintenance, and other departments to ensure customer quality expectations are understood and met.
* Monitor supplier-related quality trends and recurring issues.
* Support supplier corrective actions, quality investigations, and improvement initiatives as needed.
* Serve as a quality escalation resource for customer and supplier issues across locations.

**Quality Performance, Reporting & Risk Management**

* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, KPIs, trends, and reporting processes for the assigned facility.
* Support the development and implementation of company-wide quality dashboards and performance metrics.
* Evaluate quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Communicate significant quality concerns, regulatory risks, audit findings, and improvement initiatives to site leadership and executive leadership.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize quality initiatives and allocate resources appropriately.
* Provide visibility into quality performance across locations and recommend actions to improve overall company performance.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in aviation, aerospace, MRO, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Compliance,, Inspection, or related functions preferred.
* Significant experience leading Quality functions within aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul, manufacturing, or FAA-certified repair station environments.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience working directly with FAA, EASA, UK CAA, customer representatives, or other regulatory authorities preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory, customer, internal, and external audits.
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining Quality Management Systems.
* Strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, particularly Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Knowledge of EASA, UK CAA,, and other applicable regulatory requirements preferred.
* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause analysis, risk management, audit processes, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret technical data, regulatory requirements, manuals, procedures, engineering documentation, and quality standards.
* This role will require 20%-30% travel to other facilities

new_roles.title: Director, Operations & Quality Compliance
new_roles.description:
**Summary**

We are seeking a Director, Global Safety Operations & Quality Management to provide strategic, operational, and technical leadership across Immunic's PV operations, quality management, compliance, and inspection readiness activities for our development and post-marketing portfolio, reporting to the VP of Pharmacovigilance & Patient Safety as a key member of the Global PV leadership team. You will oversee global safety reporting, ICSR processing, aggregate reporting, safety surveillance, quality management systems, compliance, and inspection readiness, ensuring PV activities are governed, risk-based, and scalable, while providing executive-level oversight of CROs, vendors, and external service providers to ensure governance, performance management, and continuous improvement of outsourced PV activities.This is a highly collaborative and strategic role, where you must operate effectively in an evolving biotech to translate regulatory and business requirements into practical operating models, and build high-performing teams and sustainable PV capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement pharmacovigilance processes, policies, SOPs, and safety database/PV systems.
* Lead cross-functional governance, benefit-risk assessment, signal detection, and risk management efforts.
* Chair the executive safety review committee, oversee safety data exchange with partners, and contribute to industry-wide safety initiatives.
* Partner with clinical development to integrate safety into protocols, risk management plans, and safety charters.
* Provide PV oversight for regulatory filings (IND/BLA/MAA) - including Clinical Overviews, ISS, and RMPs - and review IBs, DSURs, and key CSR sections; participate in regulatory meetings as needed.
* Lead medical review of ICSRs and oversee PV team operations, quality, and compliance with global safety regulations.
* Monitor and assess CRO performance on pharmacovigilance activities.
* Recruit, hire, train, mentor, and coach PV staff, and oversee project deliverables and performance evaluations.

**Qualifications & Education**

* Healthcare professional (RN, PharmD, MD) with clinical and industry experience and a proven track record leading pharmacovigilance teams.
* Minimum of 15 years' experience in drug safety and pharmacovigilance roles in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.
* Proven leadership expertise, including a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* In-depth knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and compliance requirements (EMA/FDA/ICH).
* Strong leadership and strategic decision-making abilities to drive safety initiatives and ensure regulatory compliance.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality and Survey
new_roles.description:
At Vetter Senior Living, our mission is simple: **Dignity in Life**. We are a premier provider of long-term care, assisted living, independent living, therapy, and home health and hospice services, and our team of skilled and caring people is committed to making quality service a way of life. Our work is guided by our values of Serving, Integrity, Teamwork, and Excellence.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Quality and Survey to provide quality and survey leadership and support to our communities. Through strong personal relationships, you will help our communities and service lines ensure that quality and regulatory requirements are not only met but exceeded. This role travels between communities and serves as a trusted clinical and regulatory resource for facility leadership.

### **Benefits**

* Student Loan Repayment Assistance
* Earned Wage Access
* Medical Insurance Options
* Vision Coverage
* Free Individual Dental Insurance
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* Leadership Development Opportunities
* Career Growth and Advancement
* Supportive Senior Leadership Team
* Great Place to Work® Certified Organization

**What You Will Do**

* Monitor compliance with federal and state regulations and maintain ongoing survey readiness in skilled nursing and assisted living.
* Identify potential deficiencies early and help facility leadership develop corrective actions.
* Conduct focused and routine audits of high-risk areas such as falls, wounds, infections, medication management, hospital transfers, documentation, and changes in condition.
* Manage the iQIES and HARP systems for the organization.
* Support facility Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) activities by identifying trends, establishing improvement plans, monitoring results, and evaluating whether interventions are working.
* Provide targeted education and coaching to Directors of Nursing, nurse leaders, and clinical teams when audits or quality data reveal knowledge or process gaps.
* Drive corrective actions such as staff education, coaching, focused chart reviews, and process changes.
* Serve as a clinical and regulatory resource to facility leadership on complex compliance, resident-care, documentation, or risk concerns.
* Partner with leadership while maintaining facility accountability for day-to-day operations.
* Promote continuous improvement in quality and survey processes and outcomes, and support all Vetter Senior Living service lines and growth opportunities.

**What You Bring**

* Licensed nurse (RN preferred).
Minimum of 3* -5 years of experience in post-acute care.
* Experience managing quality outcomes, with a strong understanding of regulations and survey preparation and management.
* Excellent communication and education skills.
* Strong organizational and relationship-building skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel between communities.
* High personal integrity, a caring attitude, and a genuine desire to work with and support others.

**Why Join Us**

You will be part of a highly respected team of skilled and caring people who are committed to making quality service a way of life. Your daily efforts will help our communities deliver exceptional care, and you will find fulfillment in building relationships, coordinating care, and helping enhance the dignity in people's lives.

**Ready to make a difference? Apply today to join the Vetter Senior Living team.**

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Please Note: This position's start date is January 11th 2027.**

**Job Description**

Are you an ambitious operations leader, shift supervisor, or production lead looking to take the next major step in your career?

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on **Plant Manager** to lead the daily operations of our production, packaging, fulfillment, receiving, inventory, and warehouse functions. Reporting directly to the VP of Product + Logistics, you will be responsible for ensuring our product moves safely, accurately, and efficiently through the business.

As a small but rapidly growing company, we need a "systems builder" who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves on the floor. Because we are a tight-knit team, we are deeply committed to your professional development. If you have an outstanding track record of leadership and team-building, but have gaps in specific technical areas—such as advanced food safety or warehouse software—we are fully prepared to invest in your training and certifications to help you bridge those gaps.

**Why This Role is a Unique Growth Opportunity**

* **Direct Mentorship:** Work hand-in-hand with our VP of Product + Logistics to learn the strategic side of supply chain, budgeting, and operations.
* **Professional Development Fund:** If your food safety background is solid but not yet at a master level, we will fund and support your path to official HACCP, PCQI, or advanced food safety certifications.
* **Ownership & Impact:** You won't just be executing someone else's playbook; you will design and implement the systems (from WMS architecture to preventive maintenance) that will power our brand's next phase of growth.

**Key Responsibilities1. Production Planning & Preventive Maintenance**

* **Master Production Scheduling:** Move us from day-to-day planning to proactive operational excellence. You will own the Master Production Schedule (MPS), using sales forecasts, historical data, and retail demands to plan batch runs weeks in advance.
* **Production Oversight:** Manage the physical processing, grinding, sifting, kitting, labeling, and sealing of our artisan products.
* **Preventive Maintenance (PM):** Design and enforce a strict PM calendar for our machinery (grinders, mills, sifters) to prevent costly breakdowns.

**2. Inventory Strategy & Warehouse Architecture**

* **WMS Implementation:** Lead the strategy and physical layout for our Warehouse Management System (WMS), including mapping warehouse bins, establishing min/max reorder thresholds, and training the team on barcode scanning software.
* **Inventory Flow:** Maintain strict First Expired, First Out (FEFO) rules to minimize waste and optimize physical space.
* **Stock Optimization:** Oversee regular stocktakes, resolve POS discrepancies, and manage inventory levels across our warehouse, retail storefronts, and external markets.

**3. People Leadership & Team Development**

* **Cross-Training & Training Matrices:** Build and maintain a robust "Training Matrix" so that critical roles (such as running the mill or pulling retail transfers) are never dependent on a single person.
* **Staff Development:** Direct, schedule, and coach our hourly production, fulfillment, and receiving teams.
* **Accountability:** Conduct regular performance reviews, set clear quality standards, and directly address performance issues constructively.

**4. Fulfillment, Logistics & Financial Control**

* **Fulfillment Efficiency:** Oversee omni-channel order processing (Cin7 CORE, Shopify, ShipStation) and optimize pick-and-pack times while ensuring lot traceability.
* **Operational Budgeting (OpEx):** Help protect our margins by monitoring labor cost-per-unit, tracking waste metrics, and negotiating shipping rates with carriers.
* **Sourcing:** Direct the physical organization and cost-effective purchasing of shipping materials.

**5. Food Safety, Sanitation & Compliance**

* **Compliance Administration:** Oversee facility compliance, maintain GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) logs, and lead sanitation routines.
* **Safety Training Support:** *If you do not currently hold a PCQI or advanced HACCP certification, we will provide the training and resources to get you certified within your first 90 days.*

**Qualifications**

**Note on Qualifications:** We value a proven track record of leadership, a high level of responsibility, and a growth mindset above a "perfect" resume. If you meet the core leadership requirements, we encourage you to apply!

**What You** ***Must*** **Have (Non-Negotiable):**

* **3+ years of direct people management experience**, ideally leading hourly production, fulfillment, warehouse, or retail operations teams.
* A proven track record of growing, coaching, and organizing teams, with a reputation for high emotional intelligence and clear communication.
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with calm and clarity.
* A "hands-on" attitude—you love being on the floor with your team, solving physical bottlenecks, and keeping spirits high.

**What is** ***Nice-to-Have*** **(Areas We Can Help Train & Grow You In):**

* Experience in food production, CPG, or manufacturing.
* Familiarity with Shopify, ShipStation, ERPs or similar Inventory/Warehouse Management Systems.
* Existing Food Safety certifications (HACCP, PCQI, GMP compliance).
* Experience designing preventive maintenance schedules for mechanical equipment.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

**Milestone**

**Expectation**

**First 30 Days**

Learn our current workflow, build trust with the hourly team, and shadow our existing fulfillment and production flows.

**First 90 Days**

Implement the PM machinery calendar, assume ownership of scheduling, and establish your first team Training Matrix.

**First 6 Months**

Successfully lead the production capacity planning and take complete ownership of floor OpEx, including labor efficiency metrics.

**First Year**

Establish a highly cross-trained, self-sufficient team that operates with calm, efficiency, and zero reactive daily fire-fighting.

**What We Offer**

* Employer-sponsored health care plan
* Dental and Vision
* 401k matched (4%)
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and sick time
* Green Commuter Benefits
* Free On-Site Parking
* Employee Discounts (Including free new releases)

Curio Spice Co. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay: $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance
