General Summary
  
  
The Global Director of Quality is responsible for oversight of Quality Management and Continuous Improvement Programs for Team Industrial Services globally. The position is ultimately responsible for all corporate and Divisional Quality and Continuous support personnel. The successful candidate provides the necessary management and oversight to ensure the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of TEAM’s Quality Management System (QMS) as well as the supplemental Quality Control and Technical programs. Position is responsible for managing and coordinating all Quality support activities relating to the execution of the Quality Management System (QMS) for Team Corporate, Product and Service Line, Engineering and Manufacturing, and Operations. Global Director of Quality is responsible for operating on a cost-effective basis within the framework of company approved policies, objectives, and budgets.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Maintains a safe, secure and healthy environment by adhering to Company/Customer safety and quality standards and practices and to legal regulations, alerting others regarding potential hazards or concern
* Adheres to and is a champion of TEAM’s Core Values
* Establish a continuous improvement culture across the enterprise utilizing known methods and concepts such as Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, Kaizen, Poka-yoke, CAPA, 8D, etc.
* Maintains contact with district, division and corporate levels to promote and instill a “Quality Culture” throughout the organization.
* Ensure TEAMs QMS is globally consistent and regionally precise based on local requirements.
* When necessary, provide training to affected personnel, including customers, to obtain maximum process efficiency, productivity, cooperation, and morale.
* Leads the Enterprise management review to evaluate quality objectives, assess the adequacy and effectiveness and continuing suitability of the existing QMS and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage the Supplier Quality Management program and supports third-party and Customer assessments.
* Ensures company-wide targets and objectives are established and action plans are developed and tracked to achieve them.
* Development and implementation of performance monitoring and measurement system of leading and lagging KPIs to evaluate performance across the entire supply chain – Supplier – Order Intake - Engineering – Manufacturing – Installation – Service – Warranty.
* Development and implementation of system of associating and tracking non-conformances with costs for supplier claims, internal issues and customer escapes. This includes understanding the company’s Cost of Poor Quality and Non-Conformance Costs.
* Stay up-to-date on industry trends, including Quality-related initiatives.
* Develops medium to long-term operating strategies and recommendations for plans and programs for increasing TEAM’s Quality performance.
* Prepare capital expense and operating budgets and ensure cost-effective departmental operations.
* Support sales efforts when necessary, including the completion of pre-qualification surveys and submission of controlled quality documents to customer representatives.
* Have a general understanding of all company products and services that are available to our customers, and how TEAM’s Quality program applies to these areas.
* Ensures the Enterprise external certifications (ISO-9001, Nuclear, Aerospace, etc.) are maintained.
* Other duties as assigned

**Job Qualifications**

* Requires a bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field. Master’s degree preferred. Continuous Improvement Methodology certifications such as Six Sigma is preferred.
* Experience in Oil and Gas, Lean Manufacturing, Petrochemical, or a Field Service Industry is a must.
* 15 years’ experience in Quality or Operational Excellence related function.
* Experience with problem solving methods such as A3, FMEA, etc. preferred.
* Experience in introducing/implementing a solid warranty tracking system that captures accurate Customer and or Field related issues.

Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
  
  
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

* Holistic Health & Well-being programs

**Overview**
Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro-manufacturing and being part of something bigger
  
  
The Quality Director plays a pivotal role in leading and strengthening operational quality and quality compliance within a large-scale contract manufacturing facility. Responsible for both Product Quality and Quality Management System (QMS) compliance, this leader ensures quality operations within the manufacturing environment consistently meet customer, regulatory, and business expectations.
  
  
This individual combines strategic vision with hands-on operational quality leadership, ensuring Resonetics delivers world-class quality in a fast-paced, highly regulated medical device manufacturing environment. The role demands proven experience within manufacturing operations, deep expertise in ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820, mastery of advanced quality assurance techniques, and the ability to align and elevate quality performance across multiple value streams.
  
  
Join Resonetics and be part of a team that’s redefining medical device manufacturing. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operational Quality Leadership**

* Own and lead all aspects of manufacturing quality performance, ensuring operational processes deliver consistent, compliant, and high-yield outcomes.
* Partner closely with Operations leadership to embed quality into daily production activities and drive problem-solving directly on the manufacturing floor.
* Implement and oversee statistical process control (SPC), process capability, and other data-driven tools to ensure process stability and continuous improvement.
* Monitor and manage critical quality metrics, taking immediate action to address gaps and prevent recurrence of issues.
* Oversee validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ) for manufacturing processes and equipment, ensuring robustness and compliance.
* Provide quality leadership in New Product Introduction (NPI), ensuring robust process validation, risk management, and seamless transition from development into full-scale manufacturing.

**Quality Systems & Compliance**

* Ensure the ISO-certified QMS is operationally effective within manufacturing sites and continuously improved to support business growth.
* Maintain full compliance with ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, and other relevant standards through proactive system management and audit readiness.

**Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving**

* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for complex production challenges.
* Drive Lean and Six Sigma initiatives that enhance manufacturing efficiency while strengthening compliance and product quality.
* Share best practices across sites to ensure standardization and scalability of quality improvements.

**Customer & Supplier Interface**

* Serve as the primary quality leader for high-visibility customers, ensuring confidence in Resonetics’ ability to deliver consistently high-quality products.
* Lead the supplier quality program, ensuring raw materials and outsourced processes meet stringent requirements to support operational excellence.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Build and mentor a strong quality team embedded within the manufacturing organization.
* Provide training in advanced quality tools (Gage R&R, SPC, pFMEA, Risk Analysis, Validation, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA) to elevate operational capability.
* Foster a culture of quality culture and ownership on the production floor, engaging all levels of the workforce.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 7 years’ experience in a Medical Device Quality Management role.
* Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Demonstrated background in an ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820 quality management system.
* Strong communication skills (verbal and writing)
* BS degree in a management or engineering discipline
* Experience hosting FDA inspections and ISO audits

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in a technical, regulated environment.
* Experience with finished medical device assembly and oversight of sterilization
* Experience with Quality Management Software (eQMS) and ERP systems
* Certified Quality Auditor

**Physical Demands**

**Summit Polymers is a leading, global supplier of automotive interior systems including consoles, door panels, and instrument panels. With over 50 years serving the industry, we deliver engineering and product excellence to our customers, on time, in budget, with the latest innovations.**
JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. We don’t just fill seats, we set people on career paths. We’re always on the lookout for smart people who are committed to continuous improvement, customer service and quality.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard
+ Leads specific customer scorecard training for plant quality managers, materials managers and general managers to ensure these leaders understand scoring methodology and act to ensure scorecard success
+ Monitors customer scorecard methodology and scoring changes, and ensures corporate procedures, metrics and personnel proactively adapt to changes to ensure customer scorecard success
+ Engages with other functional departments to ensure all aspects of customer scorecards are understood and actions are taken to ensure scorecard success (examples Sales – cost reductions, materials – minority sourcing)
+ Assists in developing internal performance metrics that support successful customer scorecard results

* Interfaces with key customer personnel & engages customer quality events

+ Develops constructive relationships with key customer contacts
+ Builds customer’s confidence in SPI’s performance, capabilities, systems, and integrity
+ Represents the company at customer “quality roundtable” events
+ Reviews customer quality system requirements and specifications and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented at all levels of the organization

* Engages in significant customer quality concerns and warranty issues

+ Participates in problem solving and customer response preparation for significant customer quality issues
+ Represents the company at critical customer quality concern reviews, leading company response and negotiation to achieve successful resolution
+ Acts as point of contact for customer warranty concerns and engages plant and engineering resources to solve warranty concerns

* Provides quality expertise as a corporate resource

+ Champions Practical Problem Solving activities across the company, including improving effectiveness of management team leadership of the process
+ Key leader for development, update, training and compliance to corporate IATF-16949 compliant systems and procedures
+ Supports new business initiatives and projects with data, metrics, support plans, and technical expertise as related to quality
+ Provide support in developing and performing training plans for quality managers and quality engineers at manufacturing plants
+ Provides additional support at manufacturing plants as needed

* Other tasks and duties as assigned

**Education And Experience**

* 4-year college degree in technical or management field preferred
* 5 years’ experience in role of Quality Manager at automotive supplier preferred

**Skills And Abilities**

* Broad knowledge of quality systems and management practices in automotive plastics manufacturing operations
* Expertise in major automotive OEM quality systems; Ford Q1, GM BIQS, FCA, Nissan, VW, BMW, and Toyota
* Expert problem solving skills utilizing root cause based methods; Practical Problem Solving (PPS), 8D, and 5 why methodology
* Must be able to gather and analyze information easily and make appropriate decisions.
* Outstanding leadership, team building, coaching and decision making abilities
* Highly energetic, confident, and assertive with the ability to lead and motivate others
* Must have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
* A minimum score of 50 on the Wonderlic Select Assessment (Traditional score of 28 on the cognitive portion).

**Travel Requirements**
This position typically does require approximately 18 weeks per year of travel to Summit Polymers Manufacturing Sites.
  
  
**DISCLAIMER**
The information contained in this job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Agreement to complete all post-hire required training.

As the
**Director of Quality**
, you will lead the quality strategy and continuous improvement efforts across all Bison manufacturing sites. **Whitsett, NC**

facility.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

+ Develop and execute a strategic quality plan in alignment with business unit goals.
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals across two locations, ensuring consistency in processes and objectives.
+ Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)

+ Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the QAD Elements QMS and other relevant Quality Management Systems at both locations. Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry-specific quality standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, AS9100, etc.).

+ Collaborate with sales, operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify drive resolution of quality issues, ensuring process and product integrity.

**MISSION**

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The VP, Global GMP Quality position will be responsible for leading the GMP quality functional teams at Mirum and its subsidiaries (US and International). This position will play a pivotal role in steering the organization toward an ongoing commitment to quality improvement, driving efforts to identify areas for optimization, innovation, and excellence. This person will be responsible for managing, mentoring and supporting a GMP Operations team of clinical and commercial Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) professionals. This person will provide leadership and hands-on support to ensure the seamless execution of GMP QA and QC functions, including product quality complaint investigation, root-cause investigations, and the reporting of critical GMP issues to executive management.  This person will also be responsible for leading, providing direction, resources, and guidance to ensure that all GMP quality processes are executed with the highest standards of compliance with FDA, EMA, and other international regulatory requirements, corporate objectives, and industry best practices. This role also involves ensuring that the GMP and GDP quality functions are closely aligned with the organization’s broader strategic goals, guaranteeing that quality initiatives support the company’s mission, vision, and operational objectives.

**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader to assist the head of quality to further develop the quality culture at Mirum to be compliant, collaborative and phase appropriate.
* Develop and execute a global GMP quality strategy to align with corporate goals and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader within the Quality group to lead the GMP QA and QC functional teams in fostering professional development and guiding staff in all aspects of GMP/GDP competence in meeting domestic and international regulatory requirements and guidelines (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, ICH, etc.).
* Lead the development and optimization of key processes, functional collaboration, transformational initiatives, and operational excellence through the GMP/GDP Quality Unit.
* Serve as the GMP quality lead in Audits and Regulatory Inspections in providing strategic leadership, interactions, responses, CAPA plans and implementation.
* Lead the GMP inspection readiness for the Company including GMP Quality improvement and maintenance.
* Host/Manage GMP PAI/PLI inspections at Mirum and support Mirum PAI/PLI related CMO inspections.
* Drive corporate values, vision, goals, and objectives through collaboration with senior leaders building cross-functional networks to influence operational capabilities.
* Serve as a GMP Quality advisor to cross-functional stakeholders within Mirum global organizations and subsidiaries.
* Promote collaboration across internal and external functional teams and stakeholders to identify, design and implement opportunities for improvement across all areas of GMP and GDP quality responsibilities.
* Establish, maintain, and ensure effectiveness of GMP and GDP quality programs and documentation to assure GxP compliance in the domestic and international regulatory environment.
* Oversee, support and perform all aspects of GMP QA and QC activities and functions for drug manufacturing to ensure product quality and supply chain integrity.
* Oversee and support all aspects of clinical and commercial product release which includes direct to market, partner and distributor.
* Serve as the Material Review Board (MRB) chair-person designee.
* Develop and execute a global recall strategy that integrates domestic and international recalls.
* Serve as the Recall Coordinator in the recall committee and support the recall/mock recall process.
* Collaborate with Commercial Organization on launch strategies, NPP/EAP/CUP programs and provide input as a Quality SME.
* Review and approval of GMP, GDP, Partner and Distributor Quality/Technical Agreements.
* Oversee the review and approval of APQR generation in a timely fashion.
* Assess the outcome of GMP audits at CMOs, CTLs, Partners, etc. for a holistic view and to partner with the Technical Operations team in driving improvements.
* Provide strategic and managerial leadership related to company objectives & initiatives and changing regulatory requirements to build, manage, and mentor high-performance QA and QC teams in a global environment.
* Oversee product launch, manufacturing, and distribution quality processes.
* Lead a culture of quality excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Ensure global GMP Quality Team meets stakeholder needs, focusing on efficiency, quality, budget management, and corporate growth.
* Serve as Quality Head designee for other GXP areas beyond GMP and GDP as required.
* Requires 15% domestic and international travel, at minimum.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education /Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, chemistry, biology, or other science related field (Advanced degree preferred).
* 15+ years of progressive Quality Assurance experience in pharmaceutical and/or Biotech industries, with at least 10+ years in quality leadership role and/or people management including direct & indirect reports.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of cGMP manufacturing and Quality Management in compliance with FDA (CBER and/or CDER) and EMA requirements for global-regulated products.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of the development and commercialization of medical device in compliance with FDA 21CFR820, ISO13485 and EMA MDR regulations
* Comprehensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO, ICH, and global regulatory requirements.
* Product lifecycle including Late-stage drug development, Regulatory (NDA, MAA, BLA, etc) submission and commercial manufacturing experience.
* Experience with hosting and preparing for inspection readiness and an ability to provide recommendations for its continuous improvement.
* Must be able to work cross functionally as a strong collaborator with ability to partner with internal and external stakeholders across multiple global regions.
* Experience with managing Product Quality Complaints and Pharmacovigilance Quality is a plus
* Experience in rare disease and/or biologics, a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Extensive hands-on experience in product lifecycle management including late-phase innovative drug development, medical device, combination product and global commercial launch with global CMC regulatory filings (IND/IMPD/CTA/NDA/BLA/MAA, etc.) in a multinational pharmaceutical organization.
* Demonstrate project and cross-functional team leadership, as well as people management skills across different cultures.
* Thorough understanding and working experience in innovative drug development and manufacturing of drugs and biologics concerning GMP operations, quality systems, ICH guidelines, FDA, EMA, and associated international regulatory requirements.
* Extensive working experience with management and oversight of the analytical activities at CDMOs or CTLs with quality mind-set and leadership.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with strategic and sound technically driven decision-making ability.
* Highly effective and strong ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.
* Strong sense of ethics and honesty.
* Ability to communicate with all levels of management and peers within the organization.

**Position Overview**

As the Director of Manufacturing, you will serve as the senior plant leader for a high-volume beverage canning operation responsible for batching, filling, seaming, and packaging canned CELSIUS® beverages. You will provide strategic and operational leadership across production, quality, food safety, maintenance, engineering, safety, warehousing, workforce development, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who has operated in a high-speed, automated food, beverage, packaging, or consumer products environment. Yes

* Experience using ERP/MRP, MES, maintenance-management, and manufacturing-performance systems to make data-driven decisions
* Strong analytical, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work onsite at the manufacturing facility and support a flexible schedule based on operational needs

* Oversee inspections, testing, product release, holds, deviations, nonconforming product, complaints, CAPAs, and corrective-action effectiveness in partnership with Quality

* Collaborate with Human Resources to recruit, develop, retain, and engage a high-performing plant workforce
* Build leadership capability through coaching, performance management, individual development plans, skills matrices, cross-training, succession planning, and consistent leader standard work
* Lead labor planning and workforce optimization in response to production volumes, seasonality, new product requirements, and business growth

* Build strong working relationships with corporate brand, R&D/innovation, Quality, and Supply Chain partners, as well as co-pack customers and key suppliers where applicable
* Promote a culture consistent with CELSIUS values, including ownership, agility, grit, commercial thinking, collaboration, positive influence, and a bias for action

Build your future at Curia, where our work has the power to save lives

* Education reimbursement

At Curia, manufacturing excellence is at the heart of everything we do. The Director, Production Operations is a key member of the Springfield leadership team, responsible for managing, planning, directing, and coordinating manufacturing processes across our large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations. This leader ensures our operations are safe, compliant, cost-effective, and positioned for growth.
  
  
This is a role for a proven leader who brings both strategic vision and operational discipline. The Director contributes to the development of business and functional strategies, communicates them clearly across the site, and translates them into action. Working cross-functionally with Quality, Regulatory, and other departments, this leader drives high performance in cGMP compliance, schedule adherence, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As much as this role is about operational outcomes, it is also about people. The Director identifies and develops the next generation of leaders within the organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration that reflects the Curia Way.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**
**Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and implement short and long range goals and objectives that align with business growth and profitability targets.
* Set strategic leadership goals for key section heads within the large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations.
* Review operational plans to assess manufacturing capacity requirements and make recommendations to improve capacity utilization and support business development planning.
* Develop, implement, and maintain Key Performance Indicators and monitoring systems to drive high levels of performance within the department and across the organization.

Operations and Compliance
  
  

* Oversee manufacturing operations to ensure safety, quality, productivity, and efficiency, working collaboratively with the management team to prevent and resolve operational, quality, financial, and facility issues.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory departments to drive high performance in cGMP compliance and ensure operations meet organizational requirements for quality management, health and safety, legal, and environmental standards.
* Ensure proper planning and effective execution of production activities to minimize downtime and maximize output per the production schedule, working closely with supporting departments to maintain schedule adherence.
* Proactively lead local efforts to prepare for and execute productive customer visits.
* Analyze activities, costs, operations, and forecast data to assess progress toward goals and initiate corrective action as needed to meet business and financial objectives.
* Perform other related duties as may be reasonably assigned in the course of business.

**Good Manufacturing & Documentation Practices**
Quality is something we take pride in together. You’ll perform your work in alignment with cGMP requirements and Curia’s standards to ensure our facilities support the safe and reliable manufacture of products for our customers.

* Adhere to applicable cGMP documents including SOPs, batch records, protocols, change controls, and controlled forms.
* Keep all required cGMP training current and escalate quality concerns along with proposed solutions to the Quality department.

* Demonstrated understanding of the responsibilities and functions of key departments within a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing facility

**Preferred**

* Experience with API development and manufacturing processes
* Certification in Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma

* Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, talk, and hear.
* Frequently required to use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, and climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* May occasionally lift and/or move up to 55 pounds.
* Visual requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Regular work in a standard office environment, with frequent entry into the production area of a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility.
* Production environment may include moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, extreme heat, wet or humid conditions, low levels of toxic or caustic chemicals, and outdoor weather conditions.
* Noise level in the work environment is typically moderate.

**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24,000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible™. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).
  
  
**Senior Manager, Production – Fab Operations**
The Camas Wafer Fab is a growing 150mm, high‑volume, 24x7 manufacturing facility producing leading‑edge precision ICs in support of ADI’s diversified semiconductor business.
  
  
Reporting to the Wafer Fab General Manager, the
**Senior Manager, Production – Fab Operations**
will lead our ~300‑employee Production organization—including Production Managers, Supervisors, Trainers, 5S & Continuous Improvement, New Product Technicians, Leads, and Operators—who execute day‑to‑day manufacturing, testing, and shipping of a broad product portfolio as the fab continues to ramp, expand, and modernize a facility with over 25 years of operational history.
  
  
Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.
  
  
**Job Duties**
The Senior Manager, Production – Fab Operations is a senior operations leader responsible for translating site strategy into strong operational execution. Responsibilities are aligned to three core competency areas:
  
  
**Operational & Strategic Execution**

* Translate site and enterprise manufacturing strategies into actionable operational plans for the Production organization, aligned with objectives for safety, quality, productivity, cost, talent development, and sustainability.
* Lead the execution of production improvement roadmaps, supporting longer‑term digital transformation, automation, and modernization initiatives defined at the site level.
* Drive adoption of data‑driven and AI‑enabled decision making within production operations, leveraging analytics, automation, and machine‑learning‑based insights to improve daily execution and performance stability.
* Support change management efforts associated with new technologies, digital tools, demand shifts, and new product introductions, ensuring disciplined adoption on the production floor.
* Share and apply best‑known methods from across ADI’s manufacturing network to continuously elevate production performance.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by enforcing organizational standards, adhering to 5S principles, and complying with ADI policies, legal requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Own day‑to‑day production quality performance, applying a zero‑defect mindset using traditional quality methodologies (8D, 5‑Why, SPC) and AI‑assisted defect detection, yield analysis, and trend identification.
* Lead execution of production plans that deliver short‑term tactical results while driving continuous improvement across Safety, Quality, Productivity, Cost, and Efficiency metrics.
* Utilize predictive and prescriptive analytics, where applicable, to anticipate equipment issues, process drift, capacity constraints, and safety risks before they impact performance.
* Provide clear tactical direction through written reports, dashboards, presentations, daily operational reviews, all‑hands meetings, and shift‑level stand‑ups, ensuring decisions are grounded in accurate, timely data.
* Lead capacity modeling, scenario analysis, and demand response activities within the production organization, partnering with site leadership on longer‑range planning.
* Partner closely with Supply Chain to optimize wafer starts, cycle time, and scheduling, balancing customer demand with fab constraints and operational risk.
* Participate in internal and external audits to ensure compliance, business continuity, and continuous improvement, including adherence to ADI’s responsible and ethical use of AI in manufacturing operations.
* Support the development and ramp of new products and non‑standard fabrication requirements while maintaining safe, stable, and predictable production output.
* Ensure effective cross‑training programs and skills matrices are in place, leveraging digital tools to improve workforce flexibility and readiness.

**Effective Team Leadership**

* Lead recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training efforts for the Production organization, aligning staffing plans with quarterly and longer‑range production needs.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement through proactive communication, coaching, and visible leadership presence across all shifts.
* Develop production supervisors and frontline leaders capable of operating in an increasingly digital, automated, and data‑driven manufacturing environment.
* Execute effective performance management processes to improve team continuity, leadership capability, and operational results.
* Partner with Human Resources to support competency development, technical capability building, and training plans aligned with future manufacturing needs.
* Ensure alignment with ADI Enterprise Excellence Guiding Principles, emphasizing safety, quality, operational rigor, and responsible innovation.

**SCHEDULE**
This is an exempt role, working on‑site in Camas, Washington, primarily Monday through Friday, supporting a 24x7 continuous operation.
  
  
Occasional night or weekend hours are required to support operational needs.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field required; technical or engineering degree strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of leadership experience in high‑volume wafer fabrication or advanced manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated success leading large production teams through supervisors and frontline leaders.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with proven effectiveness in a data‑driven, metrics‑based operating environment.
* Solid working knowledge of manufacturing and business systems (ERP/MRP, MES, dispatching, capacity planning, Microsoft Office).
* Demonstrated ability to apply analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI/ML capabilities to improve safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance.
* Strong problem‑solving skills, operational discipline, and passion for continuous improvement.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, you’ll be our principal change agent, leading everything from multi-year transformation programs to focused Kaizen events. Your work will directly shape our strategic priorities by reducing waste and scrap, raising quality, speeding flow, improving the customer experience, and growing profitability.

**What You’ll Do**

Set the Strategy

* Own the multi-year CI roadmap, aligned with Restek’s strategic plan, annual operating plan, and Operations priorities.
* Establish the management system that makes improvement stick (daily management, tiered huddles, A3 problem solving) and define a CI maturity model to guide each function’s progress.
* Partner with Finance to validate savings and ensure improvement gains show up in the P&L.

Lead the Work

* Design and deliver Restek’s CI training curriculum, including Lean fundamentals, Yellow/Green/Black Belt paths, problem-solving methods, and leader standard work.
* Coach senior leaders and frontline managers in CI thinking, and develop change agents at every level to scale CI beyond the central team.

**Director of Quality**
=======================

**Colorado Springs, CO | Full-Time | On-Site**

### **Lead Quality. Develop People. Protect the Mission.**

At Cogitic Corporation, quality isn't just a department, it's critical to our mission. We manufacture precision components supporting the U.S. Navy and national defense programs, where accuracy, accountability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

We're seeking an experienced, technically strong Director of Quality to lead our Quality Management System (QMS), develop our inspection team, and drive a culture of operational excellence.

**This is not a desk-only leadership position.** We're looking for someone who can think strategically, lead confidently, and remain technically engaged. The right person is just as comfortable leading an audit or developing a quality strategy as they are reviewing a complex drawing, troubleshooting an inspection challenge, or supporting CMM programming.

If you're a quality leader who takes ownership, develops people, and believes in getting things right the first time, we want to hear from you.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Quality Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality and Inspection team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and opportunities for growth.
* Build a high-performing team that values technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and proactive problem-solving.
* Balance strategic quality initiatives with daily operational priorities to support production and delivery commitments.

**Quality Management & Compliance**

* Own, maintain, and continuously improve Cogitic's QMS, ensuring compliance with applicable customer, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
* Lead internal, customer, supplier, and external audits, ensuring findings are addressed effectively and on time.
* Drive corrective action efforts, including root-cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and verification of effectiveness.
* Ensure quality processes support traceability, documentation accuracy, product conformance, and audit readiness.

**Technical Quality & Inspection**

* Oversee inspection planning, testing, and product acceptance for complex, precision-machined components.
* Apply advanced knowledge of engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, and dimensional inspection methods.
* Provide hands-on technical support with inspection processes, CMM programming, measurement techniques, and complex quality challenges.
* Maintain oversight of measurement and test equipment (M&TE), calibration programs, and inspection equipment readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve inspection efficiency, accuracy, and first-pass quality.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Mission Assurance, and Supply Chain to resolve quality concerns and execute customer requirements.
* Lead supplier quality activities, including qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and compliance with flow-down requirements.
* Establish and monitor meaningful quality KPIs to identify trends, reduce defects, and drive measurable improvements.
* Leverage ProShop ERP, quality data, and standard quality tools to strengthen processes, reporting, and operational visibility.
* Promote a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, and doing things right the first time.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Welding Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing quality experience, including hands-on machining, inspection, or precision manufacturing exposure.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing technical quality or inspection personnel.
* Strong understanding of AS9100 quality management systems, audit processes, corrective actions, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Advanced ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, and dimensional tolerances.
* Proven ability to investigate quality issues, identify root causes, implement sustainable solutions, and hold teams accountable.
* Strong technical aptitude, analytical judgment, communication skills, and ability to balance competing priorities.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, Microsoft Office, and technical quality software.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to successfully complete required background screening and meet applicable security clearance eligibility requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting U.S. Navy, NAVSEA, nuclear, or other highly regulated defense manufacturing programs.
* Hands-on experience with CMM programming, inspection planning, and precision measurement equipment.
* Experience managing calibration and M&TE programs.
* Working knowledge of ProShop ERP and SolidWorks or similar CAD software.
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), ASME GD&T certification, or comparable credentials.
* Experience with supplier quality management, customer audits, and complex contractual quality requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

In this role, success means more than passing audits. You'll be expected to:

* Build a capable, accountable Quality team that operates with confidence and consistency.
* Maintain an effective, audit-ready QMS that supports the business rather than slowing it down.
* Reduce recurring quality issues through effective root-cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.
* Improve inspection efficiency, product conformance, and on-time execution.
* Develop stronger cross-functional partnerships and establish clear ownership of quality throughout the organization.

**Who Thrives at Cogitic?**
---------------------------

Our strongest leaders demonstrate our core values of **Performance, Character, Courage, Development, and Initiative.**

We're looking for someone who takes ownership instead of assigning blame, addresses challenges directly, coaches rather than simply directs, and understands that quality and operational performance must work together.

You should be comfortable in a growing organization where priorities evolve, expectations are high, and your leadership can make a meaningful impact.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

**Compensation:** $150k - 200K annually, based on experience and qualifications.

At Cogitic, we believe in taking care of our team and providing opportunities to grow. Our benefits include:

* **Medical Insurance:** Competitive medical coverage with employer contributions toward premiums.
* **Dental Insurance:** Employer contributes 20% toward dental premiums.
* **Vision Insurance:** Voluntary vision coverage.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Opportunity to save and plan for your future.
* **Life Insurance:** Employer-paid basic life and AD&D coverage.
* **Additional Coverage:** Voluntary life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability options.
* **Paid Time Off:** PTO and 10 company-observed holidays.
* **Professional Development:** Opportunities for continued learning, technical development, and leadership growth.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**
----------------------------

If you're an experienced quality leader who enjoys building strong teams, solving complex manufacturing challenges, and supporting work that matters, we'd love to connect.

**Apply today and help shape the future of Quality at Cogitic Corporation.**

* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.

  

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

  

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a highly motivated individual to join our team as Director, Supplier Quality to be the Compliance and Technical Lead for the global quality network of Supplier Quality Management. This role will report to the Sr. Director, External and Supplier Quality. Key responsibilities include overseeing all Quality aspects associated with global suppliers and vendors while acting as a point of contact for compliance and technical issues.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serves as the Quality lead for Company’s global suppliers and vendors.
* Develop and lead the global Supplier Quality Management (SQM) strategy, governance model, procedures, and operating standards.
* Define supplier segmentation and oversight requirements based on GMP criticality, material/service risk, patient impact, and supply-chain risk.
* Establish supplier quality KPIs and scorecards covering areas
* Provide leadership for significant supplier-related deviations, nonconformances, investigations, and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs).
* Ensure adequate root-cause analysis and scientifically justified CAPAs.
* Monitor CAPA effectiveness and recurring supplier issues.
* Lead risk assessments for changes in supplier status, manufacturing location, process, specifications, ownership, regulatory status, or business continuity.
* Evaluate quality risks associated with single-source materials, long lead-time materials, critical raw materials, and constrained suppliers.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Technical Operations to balance GMP compliance, patient safety, product quality, and supply continuity when supplier risks emerge
* Ensure audit observations are appropriately classified, investigated, responded to, and closed.
* Maintain the supplier quality system in a continuous state of inspection readiness.
* Lead escalation for chronic supplier performance problems and determine when additional controls, suspension, or disqualification are appropriate.
* May write or support review of quality agreements to ensure scope of work, compliance and testing requirements are defined accurately, including metrics, quality deliverables.
* Supports data gathering, analysis and compilation for Annual Product Reviews (APR) and Annual Vector Reviews (AVR) where applicable.
Up to 25% travel (both domestic and international)  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Advanced scientific degree (i.e. MD, PharmD, PhD) and 8+ years’ experience of Compliance and Quality Assurance/Quality Control within Biopharmaceutical or Pharmaceutical manufacturing, OR
* Master’s Degree and 10+ years’ experience of Compliance and Quality Assurance/Quality Control within Biopharmaceutical or Pharmaceutical manufacturing, OR
* Bachelor’s Degree and 12+ years’ experience of Compliance and Quality Assurance/Quality Control within Biopharmaceutical or Pharmaceutical manufacturing, OR
High School Degree and 16+ years’ experience of Compliance and Quality Assurance/Quality Control within Biopharmaceutical or Pharmaceutical manufacturing  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced science degree.
* Deep knowledge and experience in quality assurance in a highly regulated manufacturing environment.
* Well versed in Compliance, Auditing, Validation, and testing of biopharmaceuticals, preferred.
* Working knowledge of Quality Systems
* Working knowledge of current regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA, JP)
* Minimum 6 years of Compliance/QA and/or QC lab management experience in the biotech and/or pharmaceutical industry
* Strong knowledge of current GMP, SOPs and quality control processes
* Identifying, writing evaluating and closing OOS’s and investigations
* Strong knowledge or ability to understand/interpret manufacturing processes
* Process/Equipment/laboratory instrument IQ/OQ/PQ/PV
* Prior people management experience.
* Proficient in MS Word, Excel, Power Point and other applications
* Ability to communicate effectively (written, verbal) and work independently with scientific/technical personnel.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced company environment with minimal direction and able to adjust workload based upon changing priorities
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and willing to accept temporary responsibilities outside of initial job description
* Ability to think critically and demonstrate troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Ability to exercise judgement and take appropriate action where precedent may not exist
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written and presentation communication skills  

  

**People Leader Accountabilities:**

* Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
* Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.  

  
The salary range for this position is: $191,250.00 - $247,500.00. Kite considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans\*.

For additional benefits information, visit:

https://www.gilead.com/careers/compensation-benefits-and-wellbeing

Kite is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the development of innovative cancer immunotherapies with a goal of providing rapid, long-term durable response and eliminating the burden of chronic care. American Photonics, a portfolio company of BlueRock Global, is a precision optical manufacturer serving the aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, scientific, and commercial markets.

We are strengthening our manufacturing capabilities, investing in operational improvements, and expanding into higher-value precision optics and infrared applications.

We operate in a technically demanding manufacturing environment where quality, precision, accountability, and reliable execution are essential. Our focus is on building a stronger, more capable manufacturing business positioned for sustainable, profitable growth.

**Job Overview**

American Photonics is seeking an accomplished General Manager to lead overall business performance, manufacturing operations, and organizational development.

This is the senior on-site executive position, with direct responsibility for operating P&L performance and leadership across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Sales, Supply Chain, and supporting business functions.

The ideal candidate has successfully led a technically complex manufacturing business, improved financial and operational results, developed accountable leadership teams, and executed meaningful business improvements.

We are looking for a decisive, hands-on leader who understands both the financial and operational sides of manufacturing. This individual must be equally comfortable reviewing business performance, resolving production challenges, developing customer relationships, and working directly with employees on the manufacturing floor.

Reporting to ownership, the General Manager will have responsibility for translating strategic objectives into achievable operating plans, establishing clear accountability, and delivering measurable results. The position will work closely with BlueRock's corporate resources while maintaining ownership of day-to-day business execution.

**Duties**

* Assume accountability for operating P&L performance, including revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, working capital, and achievement of financial objectives.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, budgets, forecasts, workforce plans, and capital investment priorities aligned with business objectives.
* Lead Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Sales, Supply Chain, and business operations to ensure coordinated execution and achievement of company objectives.
* Improve manufacturing performance through effective production planning, scheduling, labor utilization, material readiness, equipment effectiveness, and capacity management.
* Identify and resolve operational inefficiencies, production bottlenecks, excess costs, scrap, rework, quality issues, and sources of margin erosion.
* Establish clear departmental objectives, performance metrics, reporting standards, and management accountability for results.
* Strengthen job costing, pricing discipline, inventory control, purchasing practices, and financial visibility to support profitable decision-making.

* Partner with Sales and Engineering to evaluate customer opportunities, improve quoting accuracy, assess technical and manufacturing feasibility, and support profitable business growth.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with key customers, suppliers, strategic partners, and other business stakeholders.

**As the VP, Quality Assurance & Food Safety**, you’ll report to the Bakery President and lead food safety, quality assurance, sanitation, and technical services across two bakery plants totaling more than 160,000 square feet and supporting more than 600 staff members. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact: setting the strategy, rebuilding organizational trust, strengthening audit readiness, and elevating Good Manufacturing Practices through disciplined root cause analysis and corrective action. You’ll operate at both the executive and plant levels, bringing the leadership, technical expertise, and influence needed to create lasting change.

**You’ll thrive in this position if you are:**

* **A Trusted Executive Leader:** You build credibility through transparency, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through, earning the confidence to influence decisions at every level.

* **An Audit and Compliance Expert:** You build a culture of year-round readiness where issues are identified early, corrective actions are effective, and findings are sustainably closed.
* **A Disciplined Problem Solver:** You look beyond the immediate issue, using data, risk assessment, and root cause analysis to solve systemic problems and prevent recurrence.

**Responsibilities**

Lead Cross-Department Initiatives

* Pilot solutions in one fulfillment center and scale what works across our network.

Drive Continuous Improvement

* Make structured problem solving a habit at every level of the organization.

Analyze, Build, and Drive Adoption

**About Us:**

We are committed to finding smart solutions that enable an intelligent and seamless world. Our success as a world-class leader in technology has evolved from humble beginnings. In 1896, the enterprising father and son team of A.J. and George A. Briggs partnered with S.A. Buffington, a Chicago lawyer, to establish Chicago Telephone Supply Company (later to become CTS).

Today, CTS is a leading designer and manufacturer of sensors, actuators, and electronic components for suppliers and original equipment manufacturers. We have over 20 locations in 12 countries and more than 3,500 employees. Our innovative sensing, connectivity, and motion solutions offer a diverse range of products across diversified end markets including transportation, medical, aerospace and defense, and industrial. We are at the forefront of supporting innovating life-changing technology, focusing on quality to keep people safe, healthy, and happy.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Director, North America provides strategic and operational leadership for the regional manufacturing network, ensuring safe, compliant, cost-effective, and customer-focused execution across assigned sites. This position requires a hands-on, execution-focused leader who can standardize operating processes, improve performance variability across sites, coach plant leadership teams, and convert strategic business priorities into measurable operational and financial results. This role is accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, productivity, customer responsiveness, capital execution, and people development across the North America plants.

* Deep knowledge of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, structured problem solving, visual management, standard work, and daily management systems.

* Demonstrated ability to standardize processes across sites while adapting execution to local operating realities and customer requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across operations, supply chain, quality, engineering, finance, HR, and commercial functions.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage shop-floor teams, plant leadership, executives, and customers.
* Ability to prioritize competing objectives, manage risk, lead through change, and make timely decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Proven track record of building high-performing teams, developing leaders, improving retention, and creating succession plans for critical operations roles.
* High integrity, sound judgment, and commitment to safety, quality, compliance, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

Performs duties in instruction, including the teaching of practical skills and demonstrating best professional practices. Not eligible for tenure.

**Job Description:**

The Professor of Practice & Manufacturing Extension Program Director provides leadership for the Center for Manufacturing Excellence's (CME) manufacturing extension and industry engagement activities. The position connects University expertise, educational resources, faculty, and students with manufacturers throughout Mississippi and the region to strengthen organizational performance, workforce capability, operational excellence, and competitiveness. As a Professor of Practice, the individual also contributes to CME's academic mission through teaching, applied scholarship, student engagement, and curriculum development. The position is practice oriented and is not expected to conduct traditional academic research. The rank of the Professor of Practice appointment will be determined based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and relevant professional experience.

  

The Manufacturing Extension Program Director role will develop, lead, and grow a comprehensive manufacturing extension program responsive to the needs of manufacturers and other industry partners. Working collaboratively with CME faculty and staff, industry, and economic and workforce development partners, the incumbent identifies industry needs and develops training, technical assistance, professional education, applied projects, and other services to address those needs.

  

The position will emphasize industry engagement, operational excellence and continuous improvement, applied problem solving, external funding, professional and graduate education, and measurable extension impact. The Program Director will also teach graduate and undergraduate courses consistent with the individual's expertise and support CME's Graduate Certificate in Operational Leadership and related academic and professional programs.

  

*Join the Ole Miss Family — Build Your Legacy Here!*

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Examples of Work Performed**

  

* Provide strategic and operational leadership for CME's manufacturing extension program and develop a sustainable structure and portfolio of industry-facing services.
* Build and maintain relationships with manufacturers, industry associations, economic development organizations, workforce development agencies, and other external partners.
* Identify manufacturing needs and develop customized or scalable training, technical assistance, and applied problem-solving initiatives.
* Develop and deliver programs in areas such as Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, operational excellence, project management, manufacturing leadership, supply chain, and operations strategy, consistent with the individual's expertise.
* Coordinate CME faculty, staff, students, University resources, and external subject-matter experts in support of industry projects and extension activities.
* Teach CME graduate and undergraduate courses and contribute to curriculum development to include online coursework and course/program assessment.
* Mentor and engage students in industry sponsored projects, applied scholarship, internships, and other experiential learning activities.
* Produce and disseminate practice oriented applied scholarship, including industry case studies, technical reports, professional presentations, instructional materials, and best practice resources.
* Identify and pursue grants, contracts, sponsorships, fee-based programming, and other external funding to support and expand manufacturing extension activities.
* Establish measures of program effectiveness and communicate extension outcomes and impact to industry partners, University leadership, funding organizations, and other stakeholders.

Penn Aluminum is a premier manufacturer of aluminum drawn tubing and extruded shapes, providing high quality, engineered solutions to our customers. With strategically located production facilities, we are well positioned to support our customers throughout North America and beyond.

This role leads manufacturing engineering, industrialization, tooling, test systems, automation, and technical production support for our systems products, with a strong emphasis on configure-to-order assembly manufacturing. Working closely with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, the Senior Manager will establish clear priorities, strengthen new product and production transfer readiness, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and equipment reliability.

A successful candidate will combine organizational leadership with practical technical judgment, building a team that can support daily production while executing the improvements and investments needed to scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Help to build and develop the manufacturing engineering organization. Assess current capabilities, define the team structure and staffing plan, recruit talent, and develop engineers and technical leaders to support SENS’s growth.
* Establish performance measures and execution discipline. Set departmental goals, review project and operational performance, communicate risks and resource needs, and hold the team accountable for measurable improvements in manufacturing readiness, capacity, productivity, and equipment reliability.
* Establish and execute the manufacturing engineering roadmap. Translate business growth, product plans, and production requirements into prioritized initiatives for manufacturing capacity, processes, tooling, test systems, automation, and equipment reliability.
* Lead manufacturing readiness for new products and production transfers. Partner with Design Engineering, Production, Quality, and Planning & Fulfillment to establish readiness criteria and ensure processes, equipment, tooling, test capability, documentation, and training are in place before production release.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes and standards. Establish consistent methods for process development, validation, work instructions, engineering changes, and production controls across manufacturing locations while accommodating product-specific requirements.

* Guide manufacturing technology development. Lead technical specialists responsible for manufacturing test systems, production software, tooling, and automation. Prioritize investments based on safety, quality, capacity, reliability, and financial return.
* Improve production equipment reliability. Establish equipment ownership, maintenance strategies, critical spare requirements, and preventive and predictive maintenance practices in partnership with Production and technical support teams.
* Manage projects, capital investments, and departmental resources. Develop business cases, budgets, schedules, and resource plans; oversee implementation and production acceptance; and verify that projects deliver their expected operational and financial benefits.
* Partner with Design Engineering on manufacturability. Incorporate manufacturing feedback early in product development and engineering changes to improve assembly, testability, quality, serviceability, and cost.
* Drive safe processes and sustained quality improvement. Partner with EHS and Quality to incorporate risk assessment, error prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective action into manufacturing processes and equipment changes.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of manufacturing processes, work instructions, test procedures, tooling, fixtures, automation systems, and production software solutions.
* Be directly accountable for engineering project delivery, manufacturing readiness, equipment reliability, and validated improvement benefits, while sharing accountability with Production and Quality for labor efficiency and first-pass yield (FPY).

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or an additional 4 tears of manufacturing engineering experience.
* Eight or more years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, or a related technical manufacturing role.
* Three or more years of experience directly leading engineering or technical teams, including setting priorities, developing employees, allocating resources, and managing performance.
* Demonstrated success improving manufacturing performance, with measurable results in productivity, capacity, quality, cost, or equipment reliability.
* Experience developing and improving manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and production controls, including introducing new or revised products into production.
* Ability to lead engineers and technical specialists across manufacturing processes, test systems, automation, and production support, using sound technical judgment to evaluate solutions and resolve issues.
* Practical application of Lean Manufacturing and structured problem-solving methods, including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, balancing daily production needs with longer-term improvement priorities.
* Experience planning and executing manufacturing improvement or capital equipment projects, including defining scope, schedules, resource requirements, and expected business results.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into clear team priorities and communicate progress, risks, and decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in manufacturing of configure-to-order (CTO) and engineered-to-order (ETO) electrical systems such as switchgear, switchboard, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing software development, automated test systems, and data acquisition platforms.
* Experience using ERP systems such as SyteLine for BOM management, item masters, engineering changes, and manufacturing planning.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Manager of Operations is responsible for overseeing the daily performance and overall effectiveness of Scottsdale Mint's Coining, Melting, CNC Machining, and Die Manufacturing departments. This position provides leadership and direction to approximately 30 employees, ensuring manufacturing operations are safe, efficient, productive, and aligned with company objectives.

The successful candidate will be a visible, hands-on leader capable of managing multiple manufacturing functions, developing departmental supervisors, establishing accountability, and improving operational performance while supporting current production requirements and future manufacturing growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Manufacturing & Operations Management**

* Oversee daily operations and production performance across Coining, Melting, CNC Machining, and Die Manufacturing.
* Establish departmental priorities, production goals, and performance expectations in coordination with senior management.

* Monitor production schedules and workflow, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to improve output and efficiency.
* Coordinate with Planning & Inventory Control, Fulfillment, Maintenance, Marketing, and other departments to support production requirements and company objectives.

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability to departmental supervisors and employees.
* Manage staffing levels, scheduling, attendance, and labor allocation to meet production requirements.
* Establish clear expectations for employee performance, productivity, communication, and workplace conduct.
* Conduct performance reviews, address personnel matters, and establish development objectives for direct reports.

**3. Safety, Compliance & Operational Excellence**

The Senior Manager of Operations is expected to take ownership of the overall performance of the assigned manufacturing departments.
